name: PAVREIT
recent: Pavilion REIT 于2026年10月22日发布季度业绩，并公布多项董事会及委员会人事变动。EPF 在9月底至10月中连续申报持股变动。新闻显示第三季净产业收入为 RM145.6m，节日消费预期可带动盈利。
notable: 公布2026年9月30日止季度业绩，净利 RM92.9m。
董事局及多个委员会出现人事变动，包括提名、风险、审计委员会及董事局成员。
EPF 在9月底至10月中多次申报持股变动。
risks: EPF 连续多个交易日申报持股变动，显示大股东持股出现调整。
earnings: 2026年第三季营收 RM218.9m，净利 RM92.9m，净利率 42.4%。营收环比升 3.2%，同比升 7.0%；净利环比升 4.3%，同比升 18.1%。

recent_en: Pavilion REIT released its quarterly results on 22 October 2026 and announced several board and committee changes. EPF filed consecutive shareholding changes from late September to mid-October. News reported 3Q net property income of RM145.6m, with festive spending expected to support earnings.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit of RM92.9m.
Board and committee changes involving the nomination, risk and audit committees and board members.
EPF filed multiple shareholding change notices from late September to mid-October.
risks_en: EPF filed shareholding changes on consecutive trading days, indicating adjustments in major shareholder holdings.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was RM218.9m with net profit of RM92.9m and net margin of 42.4%. Revenue rose 3.2% QoQ and 7.0% YoY; net profit rose 4.3% QoQ and 18.1% YoY.
